bio_en: Grigor Mkhitarian, called Mkho, was born in Yerevan in 1899, studied at the Yerevan diocesan school and joined the ARF as a pupil, taking on responsible revolutionary work. Arrested at the Sovietisation, he barely escaped from the Cheka prison, went to Zangezur and fought in all the battles of the army resisting the Bolsheviks. After years in Czechoslovakia, Romania and Paris he came to Iran in 1931, where at the invitation of the New Julfa community he organised agricultural work in the Peria district. He died of a heart attack in Tehran on 23 March 1960.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Not the same as Mkho Shahen (1890s Mush plain) or Gurgen Mkhitarian; check #695 'In memory of Mkho'.
